description: This file defines the SseRouteBuilder interface for constructing Akka HTTP routes for Server Sent Events (SSE) in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a fluent API for configuring authorization, event sniffer, supervision, signal enrichment, and proxy actor for SSE routes.

classes.name: SseRouteBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building Akka HTTP routes for Server Sent Events with a fluent API to configure authorization, event sniffing, supervision, signal enrichment, and proxy actors.

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Sets the authorization enforcer for the SSE route. Enables authorization enforcement to secure the connection.

methods.name: withEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets the event sniffer used for processing or inspecting SSE events.

methods.name: withSseConnectionSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor for the SSE connection, allowing supervision of the connection lifecycle.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Configures the signal enrichment provider; if unset or null, streaming requests with 'extraFields' will result in errors.

methods.name: withProxyActor
methods.description: Sets the proxy actor for streaming search results; if unset or null, streaming will fail.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the Akka HTTP Route for SSE, using the provided request context and Ditto headers supplier.
